view_meta: capability candidates the estate proposed for itself — you read the dossier and type the command; the ladder is climbed, never granted (spec/028 · TG-230).
purpose: CANDIDATES surface (record domain, epic TG-227 plane 3, spec/028 REQ-2816/REQ-2813/REQ-2817): the operator's window onto the earned op-class ladder. Recurring free-form proposals cluster into candidates with evidence dossiers; this view answers the design's five questions in order (what keeps happening / what TG wants to do / what it could break / how good its predictions are / what you must type) and exposes the two CANDIDATE verbs, ratify and dismiss. It deliberately offers NO control for the three CLASS verbs (demote, revoke, export-embed): those act on granted classes, which live on the /v1/policy/graduation ladder REQ-2817 says the console extends rather than duplicates — a control here would aim a withdrawal at a row that is not the thing being withdrawn. The ratify form is STRUCTURALLY EMPTY: no code path prefills any input from the model's text, which renders alongside as a screened, labelled, read-only exhibit. The operator types the executed vector; the laundering tripwire (server-side, ADR-0016 decision 3) refuses a template that byte-matches the model's own prose.
notes: The AUTO CEILING is rendered honestly and this is the surface's sharpest obligation: an overlay class that finishes the second climb is HELD at auto_notice with its streak pinned at the threshold, and the server DERIVES ceiling_held rather than storing it. A console that showed that class as 'still climbing' would promise a promotion that can never arrive without an embed-export MR, so the held state is captioned in words and the progress reads 'earned - awaiting embed-export' rather than a fraction. Honesty contract: NO fixture - a fabricated candidate is a fabricated CAPABILITY one ratify click from being granted; every value is fetched live via guarded liveGet. 503 renders an honest unavailable state, an empty queue an honest empty state. Write controls are data-keyed off the SERVER-computed caller_can_act and rendered DISABLED (not hidden). A RE-RENDER MUST NOT EVICT THE OPERATOR: liveAdopt() ends with route(<current view>) and liveRefresh() calls it on a timer, so every console view is rebuilt from scratch each poll. On a read surface that is invisible; here it discarded a half-authored ratification and bounced the reader back to the queue mid-dossier. ocView therefore returns the RETAINED subtree while a dossier is open — route() empties #view and re-appends what it returns, so the same DOM (and every keystroke in it) is re-attached. That fix sets no input's value; the typed text survives because the element was never destroyed, so the structural empty-form guarantee is untouched.
verified: assemble.py rebuild byte-clean and idempotent (--check); node --check on the extracted bundle passes; hash-route #candidates registers; loading/unavailable/empty/populated/read-only/dossier/ceiling-held/refresh-survival states exercised against a stubbed API via Playwright (e2e/candidates-ratify.mjs) with deterministic waits only (TG-233 — the mount waits on liveState.lastRefresh, the live layer's own boot-quiescent stamp, so the post-adopt route() cannot land after an assertion). 11 RED mutation controls, each proven to fail on its intended assertion: prefill-the-form, held-ceiling-as-a-fraction, fabricate-a-row-on-503, flatten-the-422, hide-controls-when-read-only, five-questions-out-of-order, badge-from-total-not-ratify-ready, refresh-evicts-the-operator, predictions-not-marked-display-only, a-second-ladder-on-the-candidates-surface, ladder-caption-renamed-away-from-the-existing-view. Oracle green 8/8 consecutive runs; full console e2e suite (54 oracles) exits 0.
